svg.title: Three evidence tiers for linking public accounts
svg.desc: Attested proof and direct cross-links carry more weight than shared names, photos, or other circumstantial similarities.
svg.text: How strong is an account link?
Evidence of common control is stronger than a shared handle.

g.text: A verifiable domain proof or signed statement links the accounts.
One account or owned site points to the other; reciprocal links add confidence.
A matching username, image, bio, or location is a clue, not identity proof.
